lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10 distinct vertical white line segments are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is narrowest near the shoulder and increases progressively toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is observed on the sixth vertical line from the cranial side, positioned approximately one-quarter down from the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The second and tenth lines appear as truncated or dashed segments that do not span the full vertical height of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized cluster of 7-8 high-contrast white spots is visible on the posterior haunch, exhibiting a high spatial density compared to the surrounding hide.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Four spots on the upper hind limb are aligned in a horizontal geometric row, forming a semi-connected linear appearance.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a spiral lyrate trajectory, emerging at a lateral angle before curving inward and posteriorly at the mid-section.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 1.7 times the total width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The bright ivory tips represent approximately 15% of the total vertical length of each horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron marking between the eyes and distinct white mandibular spots.
